newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil closes firmer in thin activity.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil closes firmer in thin activity.

text.p: IPE gas oil closed firmer on Thursday having range-traded for much of the day in thin volume.
"Its been an uneventful day with slack activity and no volume on the close," said one broker.
May IPE gas oil last traded $1.75 a tonne higher at $164.75.
Brokers said the contract gained little support from the U.S although continued Asian physical buying of diesel gave some supportive tone.
Resistance of $164.75 a tonne was briefly breached with an intra-day high of $165.75, but brokers said the contract was unable to consolidate the gain.
Brokers said the tone was relaxed with most business attributed to people squaring positions.
June Brent was 14 cents higher at $18.20 a barrel at 1645 GMT, after a minor spike up to its resistance level.
"New York is starting to stabilise and we had a slight pick-up just after the (gas oil) close, but $18.25 resistance seems to be holding," said one trader.
Others said Brent was stuck in a $18.00 to $18.50 range with some fund buying and locals trading sideways.
